statement: Proof-cone registry, primary-census, import-graph, and coverage inputs are content-bound to their canonical producers before they may narrow selection; unavailable or empty live census truth produces one typed fatal decision that the selector CLI, Quest proof runner, and Solver landing preflight all refuse, while valid exact, directory, and legacy-stem contract edges retain truthful per-test attribution and a digest-bound receipt.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.
